league_run_note: Third room. a1 used party v1 (325's manifest, copied as party_league96.json) and lost; a2 used the rebuilt v2 (Incineroar/Chi-Yu/Kingambit/Xerneas/Rillaboom/Raging Bolt). Rebuild reason: v1's Flutter Mane (Sucker Punch/Shadow Ball fodder), Iron Bundle (Ice into Ice) and Urshifu-SS (4x Fairy) were liabilities in the snow room; v2 keeps the Phoebe answers (Dark, Fake Out, Intimidate). Xerneas enters at L84 - the preparation API applies a legend penalty (cap 96 -> 84). Real-run carry after this room with v2: Incineroar, Chi-Yu, Xerneas fainted (Revives); Rillaboom 20/388; Kingambit and Raging Bolt full. Chi-Yu Heat Wave and Xerneas Geomancy (Power Herb consumed - no second Geomancy in Drake's room without a Center) are the carry costs.

attempts.notes: AI switched Kyurem out on T1 into Sandslash to dodge Moonblast (Sandslash resists Fairy); Ninetales set Aurora Veil T1. Urshifu OHKO'd on a switch-in by Ninetales Moonblast (4x). Specs Kyurem Earth Power OHKO'd Incineroar. Chien-Pao Sacred Sword OHKO'd Chi-Yu, Mega Froslass reset snow and swept with Blizzard/Shadow Ball. Baxcalibur never needed.

Fake Out on Ninetales + Heat Wave crit KO'd Ninetales before Aurora Veil; Kyurem Earth Power OHKO'd Incineroar from full (378). Power Herb Geomancy Xerneas + Dark Pulse removed Kyurem; Dazzling Gleam KO'd Mega Froslass and broke Chien-Pao's Sash, Sandslash Iron Head OHKO'd Xerneas (2x, Sword of Ruin). Kingambit (Supreme Overlord +40%) Sucker Punch and Raging Bolt Thunderclap closed on Sandslash and Baxcalibur.

Replay ordered after the Mega fix. Kangaskhan/Whimsicott lead fed Specs Blizzard; Draco Meteor missed Kyurem and Blizzard removed Bolt and Kingambit; Froslass Mega Evolved on its first action (a first Mega).

Fake Out + Iron Head crit KO'd Ninetales, Sucker Punches removed Kyurem, but Chien-Pao's Sacred Sword (4x) and Icicle Crash then Mega Froslass ran through a Fire-less party; Kangaskhan's Dark Sucker Punch into Chien-Pao was my misread.
Ninetales KO'd T1 again, then Chien-Pao's Sacred Sword crit OHKO'd Kingambit on entry and Sandslash's Iron Head crit OHKO'd +2 Xerneas; two crits decided it.

Fake Out + Heat Wave KO'd Ninetales (Earth Power OHKO'd Incineroar); Geomancy behind Chi-Yu's Dark Pulse KO on Kyurem; Dazzling Gleam KO'd Mega Froslass and broke Chien-Pao's Sash, Sucker Punch finished it; Sandslash's Iron Head OHKO'd Xerneas but a Gleam crit left it at 7 for Grassy Glide; Baxcalibur Protected on entry, then Icicle Crashed, and NEVER Mega Evolved across two actions; Kowtow Cleave + Sucker Punch ended it.

strategy_checks.evidence: a6 (build-12) T5: Baxcalibur entered after Froslass had Mega Evolved (T3), chose Protect as its first action and Icicle Crash as its second, and stayed base Baxcalibur both turns (item BAXCALIBRITE, mega=false). The second authored Mega still does not fire once the first has been used; build-10's fix covers only the unscored-candidate case. Its Icicle Crash (318 on Rillaboom) and Protect-on-entry were otherwise sensible.

ai_defects.description: Second authored Mega (Baxcalibur, mega_slots 4,6) never fired after Froslass Mega Evolved - same root cause as 325 defect 1 (HasTrainerUsedGimmick position-marking in src/battle_gimmick.c:120-126 gates the AI at src/battle_controllers.c:3304). BUILD-12 UPDATE: still reproduced in a6 - Baxcalibur never evolved across two actions after Froslass's Mega. Contrast: in Wallace a2 Starmie evolved only because Milotic died un-evolved; in Phoebe build-10 Banette (the first Mega used) evolved. The gate that fails is 'second Mega after the trainer's first has been used'.

a3 T2 (build-10): the AI switched Ninetales out for Sandslash into Intimidate with no threatened attack, and a6 T2 (build-12) led Chien-Pao into Kingambit's slot for a 4x Sacred Sword - fine - but a4 T3 (build-10) hard-switched Kyurem out into Kangaskhan's Fake Out for no gain.

calibration: Build-8: lost a1 (v1), won a2 (v2). Build-10/12 replays: lost a3/a4 with the Fire-less League party v3 (wrong party for this room), lost a5 with v2 to two crits, won a6 with v2 6-3. Six attempts, two wins, both with a Fire-spread party; every loss traced to party choice, misreads or crits rather than to a single member's level. Keep all offsets; Sandslash-A (+4, L98) is the member to watch - its Iron Head OHKO'd +2 Xerneas in three separate runs.
cooler: Already cool: the Kyurem switch-out to dodge Fairy and the Mega Froslass re-snow both fired. It would be cooler still with the Baxcalibur Mega actually firing (engine defect). Ninetales' Encore was never used - Fake Out or a KO removed it both times; consider whether Icy Rock on Ninetales would make the first snow phase last long enough for Sandslash to matter more.
legality: No legality problem found in the authored set.
step_up: Yes - above Phoebe. On the fixed builds Glacia is the room that most punishes a party without spread Fire: v3 (which beat Phoebe, Drake and Wallace) lost twice here. With Chi-Yu it is a 3-faint win.
